what_happened: Scene: layout/style 9 (same drawer as s2/s13/s20/s23/s27); knife (knife_8, black handle) at the back of the navy drawer near the counter edge; the board and a plate with a shrimp are on another counter 2.4 m away (left of the sink), so a long base move is needed. Stage 0 was slow (1052 vs median 486, p90 724): first close at 323 on the handle (touch 283-335, no lift); a second close starting at ~410 met the handle at 431 and lifted it (0.48 m). It then carried the knife for ~620 steps while the base turned and drove around the kitchen (600-1000; the knife hung vertically in the fingers, 'tipped' 726-1045) and released it on the board at 1050 (0.097 m from centre). Stage 1 normal: close on air at 1160, grasped the shrimp at 1185, placed it on the board at 1267 next to the knife; success at 1293.
self_recovery: Knife: one non-lifting close (323) before the lifting grasp (close begun ~410, contact 431). Shrimp: one air close (1160) before the grasp at 1185.
official_criterion_notes: Knife 'tipped' 726-1045 only while hanging in the gripper during transport; lies flat on the board at the end (tilt 0.1). close_events labels the 410 close on_nothing although it is the successful knife grasp (contact began 21 steps into the closing).

packet_facts: knife hold 431-1050 lift 0.484 dist 0.097; knife dist_to_target_start 2.41 m
